## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. List any dependencies that are required for this change.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)

- [ ] Visual / Animation / 3D shader optimization

## Verification & Testing

Please describe the tests and verification steps you ran to verify your changes:
- [ ] Executed `npm run build` with exit code 0
- [ ] Tested locally on desktop at 1920x1080 (Chrome / Edge / Firefox)
- [ ] Tested locally on mobile viewport at 390x844 (iOS Safari / Android Chrome emulation)
- [ ] Verified smooth scrolling performance and WebGL 60fps frame rate
- [ ] Captured and reviewed visual regression screenshots via `npm run shoot`
